title.zh: MODCONS项目把模块化木结构、循环利用和可拆卸设计放入同一研发框架
title.en: The MODCONS project combines modular timber, circularity, and design for disassembly

summary.zh: 爱尔兰高校和研究机构的MODCONS项目围绕模块化木结构建筑开展设计、原型和试验，目标同时覆盖结构完整性、防火、声学、振动以及未来拆卸和再利用。行业意义在于，木结构的低碳价值不能只靠材料来源说明，还要证明连接、模块边界、火灾性能和重复装配后的结构能力。对工程师而言，可拆卸性会把设计责任延伸到全寿命材料追踪和构件再认证。
summary.en: The Irish MODCONS project brings design, prototyping, and testing of modular timber buildings into one programme covering structural integrity, fire, acoustics, vibration, future disassembly, and reuse. The industry signal is that timber’s low-carbon value cannot rely on material sourcing alone; connections, module interfaces, fire performance, and capacity after reassembly also need evidence. Design responsibility is extending toward whole-life material tracking and re-certification of reused components.

watch.zh: 关注模块化木结构能否把拆卸、再装配和防火性能转化为可验证的工程要求。
watch.en: Watch whether modular timber turns disassembly, reassembly, and fire performance into verifiable engineering requirements.

title.zh: 澳大利亚研究项目探索用车辆行驶振动和物理约束AI开展城市级桥梁监测
title.en: An Australian project explores city-scale bridge monitoring from drive-by vibration and physics-informed AI

summary.zh: 科廷大学研究项目提出利用众包车辆采集的行驶振动数据，结合物理约束和生成式AI识别桥梁动力响应，服务老龄桥梁的城市级安全监测。这个方向的价值在于降低固定传感器的部署成本，同时把结构动力学和数据驱动方法结合起来。工程边界也很清楚：车辆、速度、路面、温度和交通条件会影响信号，AI输出必须经过标定、异常复核和结构工程判断，不能直接等同于损伤结论。
summary.en: A Curtin University research project proposes using drive-by vibration data collected from crowdsourced vehicles, combined with physics-informed and generative AI, to monitor ageing bridges at city scale. The value is reducing reliance on fixed sensors while connecting structural dynamics with data-driven methods. The boundary is equally clear: vehicle, speed, road, temperature, and traffic conditions affect the signal. AI output requires calibration, anomaly review, and structural judgement; it is not automatically a damage conclusion.

watch.zh: 关注行驶振动数据能否在不同车辆、温度和交通条件下保持可重复和可解释。
watch.en: Watch whether drive-by vibration remains repeatable and interpretable across vehicles, temperatures, and traffic conditions.

title.zh: 高性能混凝土桥梁疲劳研究尝试把交通应变数据直接带入性能化评估
title.en: Fatigue research on high-performance concrete bridges is bringing measured traffic strain into performance assessment

summary.zh: 昆士兰大学研究项目把疲劳与断裂力学、数值模型以及实测交通和应变数据结合，用于评估钢筋和预应力混凝土桥梁构件的疲劳损伤。对行业而言，这代表疲劳设计从固定交通谱和名义材料参数逐步走向基于实际运营数据的更新评估。工程师仍需处理传感器偏差、车辆荷载代表性、裂缝演化和模型不确定性；数据越多不等于结论自动更可靠。
summary.en: A University of Queensland research project combines fatigue and fracture mechanics, numerical modelling, and measured traffic and strain data to assess fatigue damage in reinforced and prestressed concrete bridge components. The direction moves fatigue design from fixed traffic spectra and nominal material parameters toward assessments updated by operating data. Engineers still need to address sensor bias, traffic representativeness, crack evolution, and model uncertainty; more data does not automatically mean a more reliable conclusion.

watch.zh: 关注实测交通和应变数据能否改善疲劳寿命判断，而不是只增加监测数据量。
watch.en: Watch whether measured traffic and strain improve fatigue-life decisions rather than merely increasing data volume.

area.zh: 循环木结构与可拆卸设计
area.en: Circular timber structures and design for disassembly

title.zh: 木结构的可持续性正在从材料替代扩展到连接可逆、构件可追踪和性能可再认证
title.en: Timber sustainability is expanding from material substitution to reversible connections, traceability, and re-certification

insights.evidence: MODCONS and Aarhus University sustainable timber engineering research

summary.zh: 模块化木结构的低碳和循环价值取决于整个系统，而不只是木材本身。MODCONS项目和Aarhus大学研究都把结构性能、防火、模块化、拆卸、再利用和数字化记录联系起来。对结构工程师，设计对象不再只是一次装配后的建筑，还包括连接拆卸、构件损伤检查、含水率变化、重新使用时的材料分级和防火边界。可逆连接可能降低拆卸损伤，但也会改变节点刚度、滑移和耐久性。循环设计必须有明确的验收和再认证路径。
summary.en: The low-carbon and circular value of modular timber depends on the whole system, not timber alone. MODCONS and Aarhus research connect structural performance, fire, modularity, disassembly, reuse, and digital records. Structural engineers are designing not only a building after first assembly but also connection removal, component inspection, moisture variation, material grading at reuse, and fire boundaries. Reversible connections may reduce disassembly damage but can change joint stiffness, slip, and durability. Circular design therefore needs explicit acceptance and re-certification paths.

caveat.zh: 可拆卸不等于可安全再利用；构件状态、连接损伤、含水率和防火性能必须重新评估。
caveat.en: Disassembly does not mean safe reuse; component condition, connection damage, moisture, and fire performance require reassessment.

insights.reference: MODCONS and Aarhus circular timber research

title.zh: 结构AI工具的关键不是预测得像，而是能否把物理边界、证据等级和人工复核写清楚
title.en: The key to structural AI is not visual prediction alone but explicit physics, evidence levels, and review gates

insights.evidence: Curtin University drive-by sensing and physics-informed AI project

summary.zh: 科廷大学的桥梁监测项目把车辆行驶振动、结构动力学和生成式或物理约束AI结合，代表工程AI从图像识别逐渐走向城市级资产评估。对结构工程师，真正需要掌握的是信号来源、可观测性、模型边界、异常工况和不确定性传播，而不是只比较算法准确率。数据驱动模型可以提高筛查效率，但损伤定位、承载力更新和维修决策仍需工程规则、现场检查和版本可追溯。AI工具的可信度来自明确的复核门槛，而不是黑箱输出。
summary.en: Curtin’s project combines drive-by vibration, structural dynamics, and generative or physics-informed AI, representing a move from image recognition toward city-scale asset assessment. Structural engineers need to understand signal provenance, observability, model boundaries, abnormal conditions, and uncertainty propagation rather than compare accuracy scores alone. Data-driven models can improve screening, but damage localisation, capacity updating, and maintenance decisions still need engineering rules, field inspection, and traceable versions. Trust comes from explicit review gates, not black-box output.

caveat.zh: 不同车辆、路面和环境条件会改变行驶振动信号；未经标定的模型不能直接用于安全评级。
caveat.en: Vehicle, road, and environmental conditions change drive-by vibration; uncalibrated models should not be used directly for safety ratings.

insights.reference: Curtin and UIC structural health monitoring research

title.zh: 疲劳评估正在从名义交通谱转向实测荷载、裂缝机制和寿命更新的组合
title.en: Fatigue assessment is moving from nominal traffic spectra toward measured loads, crack mechanisms, and life updating

insights.evidence: University of Queensland performance-based fatigue assessment of concrete bridges

summary.zh: 桥梁疲劳寿命受车辆荷载谱、裂缝发展、材料离散、预应力状态和环境共同影响。UQ研究项目将实测交通和应变数据与疲劳、断裂力学及数值模型结合，说明既有桥评估可以逐步从一次性设计假设转向随运营信息更新。对结构工程师，重要能力是把传感数据转化为代表性荷载、损伤变量和剩余寿命，而不是直接把应变峰值当作疲劳损伤。模型仍需处理漏测、异常车辆和未观测裂缝。
summary.en: Bridge fatigue life depends on traffic spectra, crack growth, material variability, prestress state, and environment. The UQ project combines measured traffic and strain with fatigue, fracture mechanics, and numerical models, showing how existing-bridge assessment can move from one-time assumptions toward operation-informed updating. Engineers must convert sensing data into representative loads, damage variables, and remaining life rather than treat strain peaks as fatigue damage directly. Missing data, abnormal vehicles, and unobserved cracks remain important limitations.

caveat.zh: 疲劳寿命更新依赖荷载代表性和裂缝观测质量；不能用短期监测数据证明长期安全。
caveat.en: Fatigue-life updating depends on load representativeness and crack-observation quality; short monitoring periods cannot prove long-term safety.

insights.reference: UQ fatigue research and Aarhus bridge engineering

title.zh: 木结构防火不是简单加厚：中外设计如何处理炭化、残余截面与连接保护？
title.en: Timber fire design is not simply adding thickness: how Chinese and international practice treats charring, residual section, and connection protection

text.zh: 木结构防火设计的核心不是把所有木构件做得更大，而是判断火灾作用下炭化层如何发展、残余截面能否继续传力、连接和隐蔽空间是否受到保护，以及构件在规定时间内是否满足承载和隔火目标。中国、欧洲、澳洲和美国体系在耐火等级、炭化模型、保护层、连接节点和性能化验证上使用不同表达，但共同关注火灾曲线、有效残余截面、温度梯度和结构体系的连续性。木结构模块化和可拆卸设计还增加了接口和缝隙的防火问题。工程比较应同时看材料、构件、连接和系统，不能只比较一个炭化速率数字。
text.en: The core of timber fire design is not making every member larger. It is determining how charring develops, whether the residual section can continue to transfer actions, how connections and concealed voids are protected, and whether load-bearing and separation objectives are met for the required duration. Chinese, European, Australian, and US systems use different expressions for fire ratings, charring models, protection, connections, and performance-based verification, but all address fire exposure, effective residual section, temperature gradients, and system continuity. Modular and demountable timber adds fire issues at interfaces and gaps. A meaningful comparison covers material, member, connection, and system rather than one charring-rate number.

label.en: The char layer is not the whole damage

text.zh: 炭化层、热影响区和残余有效截面共同决定构件的剩余刚度和承载力。
text.en: The char layer, heat-affected zone, and residual effective section jointly govern remaining stiffness and resistance.

label.zh: 连接节点常常控制系统性能

text.zh: 螺栓、钢板、金属连接件和模块接口可能比木构件本体更早升温，需要单独保护和验证。
text.en: Bolts, plates, metal connectors, and module interfaces may heat faster than the timber member and require separate protection and verification.

label.zh: 耐火时间必须对应真实功能
label.en: Fire duration must match the real function

text.zh: 承重、完整性、隔热和人员疏散目标不同，不能把一个耐火等级数字直接等同于结构安全。
text.en: Load-bearing, integrity, insulation, and evacuation objectives differ; one fire-rating number is not identical to structural safety.

takeaway.zh: 中外木结构防火设计的共同底层逻辑是：明确火灾目标，计算或试验残余截面，并把连接、接口和系统连续性纳入验证。炭化速率只是输入，不是完整结论。
takeaway.en: The shared logic of timber fire design is to define the fire objective, assess the residual section by calculation or test, and verify connections, interfaces, and system continuity. Charring rate is an input, not the conclusion.

title.zh: 参考实例：炭化深度与残余截面概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual charring depth and residual-section screening

intro.zh: 以下关系是根据简化炭化模型得到的派生关系，不是某一规范的编号公式。正式设计应按适用规范确定火灾曲线、炭化参数、热影响区、保护层、连接节点和耐火试验要求。
intro.en: The relations below are derived from a simplified charring model and are not numbered equations from one standard. Formal design must determine fire exposure, charring parameters, heat-affected zone, protection, connections, and fire testing under the applicable provisions.

citation.zh: Derived relation：以名义炭化速率β₀和受火时间t估计炭化深度a；真实模型需考虑方向、保护层和热影响区。
citation.en: Derived relation: estimates charring depth a from nominal charring rate β₀ and fire duration t; real models include direction, protection, and the heat-affected zone.

label.zh: 矩形构件残余面积（派生关系）
label.en: Residual area of a rectangular member (derived relation)

citation.zh: Derived relation：示意三面受火矩形构件的残余面积；实际受火面、圆角和热影响区应按适用规范处理。
citation.en: Derived relation: illustrates residual area for a rectangular member exposed on three sides; actual exposed faces, rounding, and heat-affected zone require the applicable code model.

citation.zh: Simplified screen：表示火灾设计作用效应与残余设计抗力的比值；η不是各国规范通用验收常数，限值和耐火目标必须按适用规范确定。
citation.en: Simplified screen: ratio of fire design action effect to residual design resistance. η is not a universal code acceptance constant; limits and fire objectives must come from the applicable standard.

note.zh: 例如，名义炭化速率β₀=0.65 mm/min、受火时间t=30 min，则炭化深度a=19.5 mm。若构件b=160 mm、h=240 mm、三面受火，则概念残余面积Aᵣ≈(160−39)(240−19.5)=26,680.5 mm²。该算例不能替代连接、热影响区、稳定和整体耐火验算。
note.en: For example, with nominal charring rate β₀=0.65 mm/min and t=30 min, the charring depth is a=19.5 mm. For b=160 mm, h=240 mm, and three-sided exposure, the conceptual residual area is Aᵣ≈(160−39)(240−19.5)=26,680.5 mm². This does not replace checks of connections, heat-affected zone, stability, or global fire performance.
